description_en: Verifies the enterprise name, enterprise certificate number, enterprise legal person name, and enterprise legal person ID card number. All four items must be consistent and the enterprise's operating status must be active for verification to pass
description_zh: 用于核验企业名称、企业证件号、企业法人姓名和企业法人身份证号，必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi company-four-elements-verification --ep-cert-no 92420320000000J627 --legal-person-cert-name '张三' --legal-person-cert-no '610321000000000011、510180000000000022' --auth-code Dd1r0004id --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompanyFourElementsVerification

parameters.help_en:
The name of the enterprise legal person.
If the enterprise has multiple legal persons, separate them with a Chinese enumeration comma ("、")
parameters.help_zh:
企业法人姓名。
如果企业有多个法人，法人之间需用中文顿号（”、”）隔开
parameters.name: legal_person_cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number of the enterprise legal person.
If the enterprise has multiple ID card numbers, separate them with a Chinese enumeration comma ("、")
parameters.help_zh:
企业法人身份证号码。
如果企业有多个身份证号，身份证号之间需用中文顿号（”、”）隔开
parameters.name: legal_person_cert_no

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.
Log on to the Cell Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC) and go to the My Applications (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply) page to obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。
登录号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC)，在我的申请 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

EnterpriseStatus.description_en: The operating status of the enterprise

OpenTime.description_en: The business term of the enterprise

items.description_en:
EpCertName: enterprise name
EpCertNo: enterprise certificate number
CertName: enterprise legal person name
CertNo: enterprise legal person certificate number
items.description_zh:
EpCertName：企业名称
EpCertNo：企业证件号
CertName：企业法人姓名
CertNo：企业法人证件号

ReasonCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:

0: Verification passed.
1: Verification passed, but the enterprise is not operating normally.
2: The legal person and enterprise information are inconsistent.
3: The enterprise four-element verification failed.
4: The enterprise was not found.
5: The legal person was not found in the database
ReasonCode.description_zh:
核验结果编码。取值：

0：核验一致
1：核验一致，企业非正常营业
2：法人与企业信息核验不一致
3：企业四要素不通过
4：查无此企业
5：库中无此法人

VerifyResult.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:
true: The information is consistent and the enterprise is operating normally.
false: Verification failed
VerifyResult.description_zh:
核验结果。取值：
true：信息核验一致，且企业正常经营。
false：核验不通过

Message.description_en: The description of the returned status code

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. The ID returned for each request is unique and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
